text:
jason: FYI prepping the Private VPC bundle for Cust-Delta. Target handoff window 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. Need final submanifest pin + signer rotation before we hand to delivery team.
li-chen: noted. I'll produce checksums and a signed submanifest by EOD. which KMS should we use for the cosign key?
samir: use the staging KMS key id: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/pk/cryptoKeys/airgap-stg-key. key rotation planned tomorrow morning — make sure expiration >= 30d.
maria: recommend freezing image tags for the canary (no semver bump during canary). We should also publish a fallback tag (v2.11-fallback) for instant rollback.
jason: yes to freeze. Also add a canary routing policy: 5% traffic for 2h, escalate to 25% if green. Rollback condition: error rate > 1% or median latency regression > 20%.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-start for bundle cust-delta at 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z. Job id: db-84921. Notifying ops channel at T-30m.
li-chen: checksum manifest snippet I'm pushing (copied below). I'll cosign after samir confirms KMS usage.
```submanifest:
  customer: cust-delta
  artifacts:
    - image: registry.redwood/private/cust-delta/installer:v2.11
      sha256: 3b2f7e9a...
    - image: registry.redwood/private/cust-delta/sidecar:v1.4
      sha256: a9c4d12b...
  pin: v2.11-20260402
```
samir: KMS ok. cosign command I'll run: `cosign sign --key kms://projects/.../cryptoKeys/airgap-stg-key cosign.sig submanifest.yaml` — note: cosign will add timestamped signature. Check that `pin` matches the signed manifest.
ops-bot: preflight checks passed for bundle cust-delta (checksums match, images reachable from staging mirror).
maria: add a release note snippet for Customer Success: short instructions on handoff and on-prem operator steps + offline verification (checksum verify, cosign verify). Keep it < 6 bullets.
jason: Good. Also include an explicit operator rollback command in release notes: `kubectl set image deploy/installer installer=registry.redwood/private/cust-delta/installer:v2.10 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/installer` — test in staging before sending.
li-chen: cosign done, pushed signature to signer-bucket with kube acl. Manifest pin `v2.11-20260402` confirmed. Upload link: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/cust-delta/v2.11/submanifest.yaml.sig
samir: quick note — the cosign signature TTL is 90d, but the KMS scheduled rotation at 2026-04-03 won't affect existing signatures. We're safe for handoff.
jason: OK next steps: (1) ops oncall watch 22:00-00:00 UTC, (2) CSM to coordinate customer window, (3) deliverer to start SFTP handshake at +15m. Who owns SFTP?
maria: I'll ping delivery-ops oncall. I'll also prepare the 6-bullet release note and post in #customer-success channel once deploy-bot marks canary-start.
deploy-bot: canary-start executed at 2026-04-02T22:00:02Z. canary id: cny-3124.
ops-bot: canary health check 00:05: PASS (error rate 0.12%, median latency +3%).
jason: if canary remains green at T+2h we'll proceed to 25% then full roll. If not, rollback plan in release notes is the source of truth.
li-chen: all artifacts and signatures archived under s3://airgap-archives/cust-delta/v2.11.
maria: oncall acknowledged. delivery-ops confirmed SFTP window at 22:15 UTC.
samir: thumbs up. I'll monitor cosign logs for anomalies during the handoff window.
jason: thanks all — final checklist done. :thumbsup:
